definitions.explanation: A humble way to refer to one's own wife when speaking to others. This is a traditional term used by men when referring to their wives.

examples.japanese: {家内|かない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}っています→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My wife has gone shopping now.

examples.japanese: {家内|かない}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll call you after talking with my wife.

examples.japanese: {家内|かない}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is a dish my wife made.

examples.japanese: {家内|かない}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれます→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My wife is good at cooking and makes delicious food every day.

examples.japanese: {家内|かない}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I look forward to traveling with my wife, just the two of us.

notes: {家内|かない} literally means 'inside the house' and is a humble term traditionally used by husbands to refer to their own wives. Like ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧, some consider it old-fashioned or implying a traditional gender role. Modern speakers often prefer ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧. When referring to someone else's wife, use ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧ (okusan).
